label: Nyaa
description: Unofficial plugin from gamegrab-sources, not part of droidtop and not affiliated with Nyaa or Sukebei. Searches the games categories of Nyaa (and Sukebei, if you turn it on) and hands a torrent you pick to a torrent app you have installed; droidtop has no torrent client.

permissions.reason: Searches the sites' public RSS feeds
Hands a torrent's magnet link to a torrent app you have installed (droidtop has no torrent client)
